_doc: The null game's UI pin file (the ui_pins role of its DLL; schemas/ui_pins.schema.json, checked by proxy/tools/fetch_ui.py --check): the sources the in-game RmlUi host builds from (docs/PROXY_UI.md). proxy/tools/fetch_ui.py fetches each by commit or sha256; nothing is vendored. A game copies an entry from here; change a pin only with a reason in the job report.

rmlui.why: the RmlUi version the host is written against (docs/PROXY_UI.md: -DRMLUI_VERSION in proxy/tools/build.sh)

freetype.why: RmlUi's font engine, TrueType modules only and no optional dependencies (proxy/tools/build.sh, docs/PROXY_UI.md)

lua.why: the engine's Lua 5.1.1; the same tarball as proxy/tools/fetch_lua.py PIN (tests/test_moved_tools.py checks they agree); built here with float lua_Number

stb_image.why: PNG and JPEG decoding for the host's images (docs/PROXY_UI.md); the same stb commit as stb_image_write

stb_image_write.why: J30: the in-game host's lossless backbuffer dump (ctl ui dump) writes PNG; the same stb commit as stb_image
